# Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)

library(randomForestExplainer)
```


# RF model to classify if image can be segmented for lipid
```{r}
uvp6_amund <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_amundsen2023/Calanus/ecotaxa_export_10101_20250117_1943.tsv",sep = '\t', header = TRUE) %>% 
  arrange(-img_rank) %>%  
  distinct(object_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(object_id, 
         # lat = object_lat, lon = object_lon, depth = object_depth_min,
         # date = object_date, time = object_time,
         # annotation = object_annotation_category, sample_id, sample_cruise,
         Major = object_major, Minor = object_minor, Perim = object_perim.,
         Feret = object_feret, Area = object_area, Elongation = object_elongation,
         VerSym = object_symetriev, VerSym2 = object_symetrievc, 
         Circ = object_circ., Thickr = object_thickr, 
         Meangrey = object_mean, Medgrey = object_median,
         Histgrey75 = object_histcum3, 
         Sdevgrey = object_stddev, Skewgrey = object_skew,
         Fractal = object_fractal, 
         Perim.Feret = object_perimferet,
         Perim.Major = object_perimmajor) 


image_class <- read.csv("C:/Users/patri/python_workspace/test_lipid_classification/metadata_uvp6_lipid.csv")

traindata <- image_class %>% 
  rename(object_id = filename) %>% 
  mutate(object_id = str_remove(object_id, ".png")) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_amund) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("object_id") %>% 
  mutate(label = factor(label))

set.seed(888)
model.lipid <- randomForest(label ~ .,
                      data = traindata, 
                      importance = TRUE, proximity = TRUE)
model.lipid 
plot(model.lipid)


```

## ordination of the RF results
```{r}
dist.mat <- dist(1 - model.lipid$proximity)
mds.stuff <- cmdscale(dist.mat, eig = TRUE, x.ret = TRUE)
mds.var.per <- round(mds.stuff$eig/sum(mds.stuff$eig)*100,1)

mds.values <- mds.stuff$points
mds.data <- data.frame(Sample = rownames(mds.values),
                       X = mds.values[,1],
                       Y = mds.values[,2],
                       Lipid = traindata$label)

ggplot(data = mds.data, 
       aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Lipid)) +
  xlab(paste("MDS1 - ", mds.var.per[1], "%")) +
  
  ylab(paste("MDS2 - ", mds.var.per[2], "%")) +
  ggtitle("RF Lipid mass")
```

## importance of parameters
Gini: degree of probability is wrongly classified when randomly chosen. '0' denotes that all elements belong to a certain class or there exists only one class (pure), and '1' denotes that the elements are randomly distributed across various classes (impure)
```{r}
plot_multi_way_importance(model.lipid, size_measure = "no_of_nodes")
plot_multi_way_importance(model.lipid, x_measure = "accuracy_decrease", y_measure = "gini_decrease", size_measure = "p_value", no_of_labels = 5)

```
